demoStory.title: Campus overview
demoStory.detail: Start on the command center. Demand, cost, solar, battery, grid, and savings are already live.

demoStory.title: Open Computer Lab 204
demoStory.detail: The lab is in session with 24 occupants.

demoStory.title: Lab becomes unoccupied
demoStory.detail: Occupancy falls from 24 to 0. Lights, computers, and HVAC stay on.

demoStory.title: Unnecessary consumption
demoStory.detail: The advisor flags the empty lab. This is waste, not a busy hour.

demoStory.title: Why it matters
demoStory.detail: Open the explanation: what happened, why, and the cause.

demoStory.title: Estimated savings
demoStory.detail: $3.40 today and $102 over the month, at 94% confidence.

demoStory.title: Apply the optimization
demoStory.detail: The rules engine runs the plan. Local-only Light-204-03 is skipped.

demoStory.title: Devices change state
demoStory.detail: Remote lights and inactive computers are off. HVAC-204 is in Eco.

demoStory.title: Demand falls
demoStory.detail: Campus power and the energy flow both drop by the measured saving.

demoStory.title: Solar surplus
demoStory.detail: Generation stays high while demand falls to 51 kW, leaving 31 kW of surplus.

demoStory.title: Battery charges
demoStory.detail: Apply the charge plan. State of charge moves from 63% to 74%.

demoStory.title: Battery supplies the building
demoStory.detail: Discharge cuts grid import and records the avoided peak cost.

demoStory.title: Savings for the day
demoStory.detail: Energy saved and cost avoided, with the daily and monthly projection.
